Here’s a complete breakdown for how to **structure your MedSpa agency’s “Full Growth Partnering Package” pricing**, including how to cover your tech partner (30%), VA, closer, and still maintain strong margins for yourself.

---

## 🧭 Package Overview

**Service Inclusions**
- Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram) + Creative Optimization  
- LinkedIn + Cold Email Outreach (B2B/B2C)  
- AI Automations (chatbots, follow-ups, lead routing, etc.)  
- CRM Setup & Tracking (e.g., Acquisity or Fully Booked CRM)  
- Sales Support (scripts, closer calls, AI SDR setup)  
- Service Restructuring (packaging, pricing, offers)  
- Membership Setup (recurring models, loyalty tracking)  
- Exit Guidance (positioning for private equity or acquisition)

This is a **hybrid model** that blends **agency + consulting + performance partnership** — which justifies a premium, multi-tiered fee structure.

---

## 💰 Fee Structure Options

### **1. Flat Retainer + Rev-Share Hybrid (Recommended)**
This model balances predictable cash flow with performance upside.

| Tier | Monthly Retainer | Rev-Share | Ideal Client Size |
|------|------------------|-----------|-------------------|
| **Starter Partner** | $6,000–$7,500 | 5% on new rev | <$80K/mo medspa |
| **Growth Partner** | $8,000–$10,000 | 7% on new rev | $80K–$150K/mo medspa |
| **Elite Partner** | $12,000+ | 10% on new rev | $150K+/mo or multi-location |

**Structure Example:**
- $8,000/mo base fee  
- +7% of net-new monthly revenue (verified via CRM)  
- 90-day minimum, then month-to-month  

**Why it works:** Gives clients accountability and confidence while giving your team performance-based upside.  

---

### **2. Performance-Only (Rev-Share + Setup Fee)**
For clients hesitant on retainers but open to partnership.

| Fee Type | Range |
|-----------|--------|
| Setup Fee | $7,500–$10,000 (1-time) |
| Rev-Share | 10–15% of net-new revenue |
| Term | 6–12 months minimum |

**Structure Example:**
- $10K setup (includes CRM, systems, offers, automations)
- 12% of new revenue generated monthly
- Minimum 6-month agreement

Use this for clients with **existing revenue** ($80K+/mo) and **solid fulfillment**, since results are faster.

---

### **3. Full Retainer Model (For Scaling Agency)**
If you want cash stability and less dependency on performance tracking.

| Package | Monthly | Notes |
|----------|----------|-------|
| Growth Package | $7,500 | Includes ads + CRM + automation |
| Executive Partner | $9,000 | Adds offer restructuring + B2B outreach |
| PE Readiness Plan | $12,000 | Includes valuation prep, branding, data tracking |

---

## ⚙️ Profit Allocation Model

Assume: $10,000/mo client  
→ You keep **~45%** profit after paying tech, closer, VA.

| Role | % or Flat | Description |
|------|------------|--------------|
| Tech Partner | 30% ($3,000) | Backend builds, automations, tracking |
| VA / Ops | 10% ($1,000) | Data entry, follow-ups, CRM tasks |
| Closer | 10% ($1,000) | Paid per deal closed |
| You (Strategy & Oversight) | 50% ($5,000) | Profit + leadership margin |

That leaves a **net margin of ~45–50%**, which is sustainable and scalable.

---

## 🧩 Add-On Upsells
You can build extra profit via add-ons:

| Add-On | Price |
|--------|-------|
| Custom AI SDR setup | $2,500–$4,000 one-time |
| Video ad creative packages | $1,500–$3,000 |
| Membership launch funnel | $2,500–$5,000 |
| Private Equity Positioning Audit | $5,000 flat |
| Exit Readiness Deck + Valuation | $7,500–$12,000 |

---

## 📈 Example Financial Model

**Client pays:** $8,000/mo  
**You pay out:**  
- Tech Partner: $2,400  
- VA: $800  
- Closer: $800  
- **You net:** $4,000/mo  
→ Annualized profit = $48,000 per client  
With 10 clients, you’re at **$480K net profit annually**.

Add performance bonuses or rev-share (another $5–15K/mo), and total can easily exceed **$600K–$700K/year** net.

---

## ⚖️ Bottom Line Recommendation
Use this hybrid model for most clients:

> **$7,500–$10,000/month retainer + 5–10% rev-share on new revenue**

and allocate:
- 30% to tech partner  
- 10% to VA  
- 10% to closer  
- 50% retained for profit, leadership, and reinvestment  

This gives your agency healthy margins, scalability, and the flexibility to grow your team without burning out.

---
